findings.title: Cache is overwritten with nil/partial result on error
findings.body: `entryPointAssetsCache = result` is executed unconditionally, even when `err != nil` and `result == nil`. A transient failure (e.g. CDN/file read error) therefore clears a previously valid cached value, forcing every subsequent request to re-read the manifest and potentially return errors. Only assign the cache when `err == nil && result != nil`.

findings.title: No re-check of cache after acquiring write lock
findings.body: After the RLock fast path fails, the code takes the write lock but does not re-check `entryPointAssetsCache`. Under concurrent startup load, N goroutines queued on the write lock will each re-read and re-parse assets-manifest.json even though the first one already populated the cache. Add a double-checked `if cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil { return ... }` after acquiring the lock.
